watches.name: MEK1
watches.description: Prototype no 2 of 3. -ONLY ONE AVAILABLE- The BUUR+ MEK1 is our first mechanical watch. This particular MEK1 has golden and silver coloured, and golden hands. The trades of this watch is a clean, subtle and very legible design which will take you back to your fathers or grandfathers watch collection. Note that this watch is not new. It has been used on very few occassions but it looks new. We hope that it will feel as if it was yours always. So, if you are looking for a special watch that no one else in the universe has, this is the one. This BUUR+ MEK1 prototype will come with a brown Italian veg tan leather strap and a black ditto, as well as our black leather travel case (contact us if you would like a different combination). watches.name: Meeresforscher - Diver
watches.description: Prototype no 1 of 2. -ONLY ONE AVAILABLE- The BUUR+ Meeresforscher is our combined diver and travellers watch. It has not made it into production yet and we don not know if it ever will, but as a test we are now selling one of the two protypes. This is the Meeresforscher with white indexes. It features a date window at 3 and a 24 hour hand for your travels. On the dial you also find a decompression scale which you may recognise if you are a certified scuba diver. If you are more comfortable with splashing about in the water or snorkelling the watch is safe for that too being waterproof to 20 atm. You may also notice the small anglerfish near the center and on the back case. Note that this watch is not new. It has been used on very few occassions but wil come with, two new straps a fresh battery and pressure test. So, if you are looking for a special watch that no one else in the universe has and that you can explore the world and the seas with, this is the one. T his BUUR+ Meeresforscher Prototype will be fitted with a Milanese mesh and come with an additional brown Italian veg tan leather strap, as well as our black leather travel case. Specifications: STAINLESS STEEL: 316L CASE CASE SIZE: 38MM (diameter w/o crown) X 45MM (lug to lug) LUG WIDTH: 18MM THICKNESS: 11,4MM MOVEMENT: SWISS QUARTZ MOVEMENT CURVED SAPPHIRE GLASS WATER RESISTANT 20 ATM Note that this product is not subject to any discount codes.

watches.name: Tungl in Cream
watches.description: This is our moonphase calendar - TUNGL "The one with the cream dial" FREE WORLDWIDE SHIPPPING ON ALL ORDERS Specifications: STAINLESS STEEL: 316L CASE CASE SIZE: 38MM (diameter w/o crown) X 45MM (lug to lug) LUG WIDTH: 18MM THICKNESS: 11,4MM SWISS MADE MOVEMENT: SWISS QUARTZ MOVEMENT DOUBLE DOME HESALITE GLASS WATER RESISTANT 5 ATM BLACK LEATHER TRAVEL CASE INCLUDED Tungl is Icelandic for ‘moon’ and to our ear it sounds both heavy and dark but also mythical and magical. The Tungl moonphase is the first idea we brought to life. Conceived from 40’s nostalgia, we imagined it being on the wrist of Cary Grant in a scene from ’North by Northwest’. Inspired by the golden era of similar timepieces it is both adaptable and robust. The curves are a vital part of the design. The curved dial, the curved hands and the curved glass are all created to emulate the feel of a vintage watch. You can’t choose a wrong strap for the cream Tungl. They all compliment the dial in each their way. But.. The Milanese mesh creates a light and well balanced look that just screams out for summer and cocktails. The mesh strap gives the cream dial an extra creaminess which is too good. This combination will go well with every attire you can think of. The brown Italian leather matches the warmth of the cream dial and the golden details and gives the watch a soft and classic vintage look. Also, the brown leather strap will go with any type of formal wear. For a hard business look we recommend the black or the blue strap.

watches.name: Multiscale in White with black markers
watches.description: This is our Chronograph - Multiscale. Right now we offer 20% on this watch. The discount will be added automatically at check out. For a limited time only. FREE WORLDWIDE SHIPPPING ON ALL ORDERS Specifications: STAINLESS STEEL: 316L CASE CASE SIZE: 38MM (diameter w/o crown) X 45MM (lug to lug) LUG WIDTH: 18MM THICKNESS: 11,4MM SWISS MADE MOVEMENT: SWISS QUARTZ MOVEMENT DOUBLE DOME HESALITE GLASS WATER RESISTANT 5 ATM BLACK LEATHER TRAVEL CASE INCLUDED The Multiscale is our take on the classic chronograph with multiple scales: Tachymeter, Telemeter and Pulsemeter. The curves are a vital part of the design. The size, the curved dial and the curved glass are all created to emulate that certain feel of a vintage watch. The Multiscale is an acknowledgment that sometimes more is more. A chronograph is the type of watch you can wear in any occasion without feeling underdressed OR overdressed. A chronograph should be sporty and light and compliment both a well-tailored suit and a track suit. If the Grey Italian suede is not your first choice you should most definitely consider it to be your second choice. It is a match made in heaven, well perhaps not heaven, but it does looks fantastic. The blue Italian leather strap is our other recommendation for this particular watch. The blue leather strap will enhance the look of the blue hour and minute hands and make them stand out even more.
